verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair axis for a knowledge-base app, but the evidence shows no user-configurable automations, scheduled jobs, or autonomous agents that run in the background. The midnight auto-creation of a Journals page is a fixed built-in behavior, not a user-set automation. The plugin marketplace, local HTTP API server, and logseq:// protocol are developer building blocks a user could build automations on, which earn no credit here.
